source.title: TDEC Laboratories Certified for Drinking Water Analyses (Commercial) PDF dated 03/17/2026 + TDEC Microbiological certified labs PDF + TDH Division of Laboratory Services Environmental Microbiology / Chemistry private-well path
limitations: TDEC Commercial Laboratories PDF footer: Page x of 12 (03/17/2026). Title: Laboratories Certified for Drinking Water Analyses / Commercial Laboratories Certified for Drinking Water Analysis.
In-state military/federal entries omitted from commercial table: BNH AEDC Chemistry Lab (Arnold AFB); DOE Y-12 CNS National Security Complex; NAS Arnold AFB WTP (Old ATA) Micro Lab.
All out-of-state labs on the commercial PDF omitted from the main table — cite/link TDEC commercial PDF only.

Microbiological Laboratories PDF archived and linked for additional micro-only / utility context; commercial table uses the Commercial Laboratories PDF in-state commercial/independent/university rows.
Microbac Laboratories, Inc - Nashville (Lab ID 03073) prints address 505 East Broadway Avenue, Maryville, TN 37804 with Nashville phone 615-242-1480 — transcribed as printed.
Commercial private-well acceptance unknown for every commercial row — call first.

TDH Environmental Microbiology page states it accepts samples from private wells (Total Coliform/E. coli); Chemistry Laboratory states samples typically sourced from private wells among other sources. Fees/prices intentionally omitted.

TDH Well Water Test Kit Instructions PDF (V1. 10/3/2024) describes a home coliform presence/absence color kit (purple/yellow) and Waterborne.Health@tn.gov / 615-532-7111 — documented as related guidance, not as a certified-lab submission path.
Private Water Supply hub URL referenced on the kit PDF was not located (404s at common paths); flyer + TDH lab page used as working private-well contacts.
Stale health.tn.gov approved-commercial-labs PDF (rev ~2017) archived for contrast only — not used for the table.

verified_paths.name: TDH Division of Laboratory Services — Environmental Microbiology (private wells)
verified_paths.notes: TDH lab page: Environmental Microbiology Unit performs bacteriological analyses on water samples from both public and private water systems; accepts samples from private wells; Total Coliform/E. coli by presence/absence or quantitative means; provides sterile bottles with required forms. Contact Kristin Dunaway, Supervisor, Environmental Microbiology — Kristin.Dunaway@tn.gov · 615-262-6337. Central lab: 630 Hart Lane, Nashville, TN 37216 (carrier) / P.O. Box 305130, Nashville, TN 37230 (USPS). Williamson County flyer corroborates: testing by TDH Division of Laboratory Services, 630 Hart Lane; supply request TDOH-ENVLogin.Health@tn.gov or 615-262-6337.

verified_paths.name: TDH Division of Laboratory Services — Chemistry Laboratory (environmental / drinking water including private wells among sources)
verified_paths.notes: TDH lab page Chemistry Laboratory: samples typically sourced from lakes, streams, rivers, ponds, open wells, private wells, unprotected springs, or sources with visible contamination. Bottle orders: TDOH-EnvLogin.Health@TN.gov or Chemistry Laboratory Manager 615-262-6346. Confirm current private-well acceptance, parameters, and fees with the lab before collecting.
